If `row` is `null`, `questionPayload` will also be `null`. Accessing properties directly on `row`, `questionPayload`, `posture`, or `paperScope` without optional chaining can lead to runtime `TypeError` crashes.

Using optional chaining (`?.`) ensures safe property access and robust defensive programming.

```javascript
function buildIdentity(row = {}) {
  const questionPayload = readQuestionPayload(row);
  const posture = readPosture(row);
  const paperScope = readPaperScope(row);

  return {
    question_id: normalizeNullableString(row?.question_id ?? questionPayload?.question_id),
    question_key: normalizeNullableString(posture?.question_key ?? row?.question_key),
    source_kind: normalizeNullableString(questionPayload?.source_kind),
    subject_code: normalizeNullableString(questionPayload?.subject_code ?? paperScope?.subject_code),
    storage_key: normalizeNullableString(questionPayload?.storage_key),
    paper_code: normalizeNullableString(paperScope?.paper_code ?? row?.paper_code),
    question_ref: normalizeNullableString(paperScope?.question_ref ?? row?.question_ref),
    source_pdf: normalizeNullableString(paperScope?.source_pdf ?? row?.source_pdf),
    year: Number.isInteger(paperScope?.year) ? paperScope.year : null,
    session: normalizeNullableString(paperScope?.session),
    paper_number: Number.isInteger(paperScope?.paper) ? paperScope.paper : null,
    variant: Number.isInteger(paperScope?.variant) ? paperScope.variant : null,
    q_number: Number.isInteger(questionPayload?.q_number)
      ? questionPayload.q_number
      : (Number.isInteger(paperScope?.q_number) ? paperScope.q_number : null),
  };
}
```

If `row` is `null`, `readQuestionPayload(row)` returns `null`. Accessing `.release_scope_status` directly will throw a `TypeError`.

Using optional chaining (`readQuestionPayload(row)?.release_scope_status`) avoids potential crashes.

```suggestion
    release_scope_status:
      normalizeNullableString(readQuestionPayload(row)?.release_scope_status)
      ?? FALLBACK_MODE,
```

Fixed in e94cd781a: attachRuntimeApiProjectionContract now returns nullish rows unchanged before posture checks or object spreading, with service coverage ensuring rows without projection posture do not get a runtime contract invented.
Fixed in e94cd781a: buildIdentity now uses optional access across row, questionPayload, posture, and paperScope so null/default projected rows fail closed instead of throwing.

Fixed in e94cd781a: readQuestionPayload now normalizes non-object rows to {}, readPaperScope uses optional access, and the projection contract test covers null, undefined, and empty rows failing closed without throwing.
Fixed in e94cd781a: release_scope_status now reads through readQuestionPayload(row)?.release_scope_status and falls back to non_released_fallback for missing/default rows.
Fixed in e94cd781a: buildActiveScopeBundle keeps identity as an explicit dependency, uses identity?.question_id at the typed-ref boundary, and defensively reads optional question payload fields.
